name: Stuff retailer regression shop v1
purpose: One repeatable grocery shop for voice parsing, product matching, pricing, retailer handoff and restricted-item checks.
spoken_script: I need one three litre full cream milk, a one kilo box of Weet-Bix, a 250 gram punnet of baby tomatoes, one 400 gram tin of diced tomatoes, 750 grams of cheddar cheese, one loaf of white bread, a pack of six white rolls, one pack of pork sausages, one kilo of chicken breast, one kilo of bananas, two avocados, a dozen eggs, one kilo of Greek yoghurt, the cheapest suitable twelve pack of toilet paper, two litres of laundry liquid preferably on special, one 24 can pack of Coca-Cola Zero, one packet of Arnott's BBQ Shapes, four salmon fillets, one litre of olive oil, a bag of apples, a pack of four chocolate muffins, and a bottle of wine.

expected_list.name: wine
expected_list.check: must remain on Stuff list but must not be automatically matched or added to retailer cart

pass_rules.voice: No invented groceries; quantities and pack sizes remain materially correct.
pass_rules.matching: Fresh/canned distinctions, brand variants and requested sizes must not be replaced by obviously wrong products.
pass_rules.restricted: Wine is never automatically searched, matched or added to a retailer trolley/cart.
pass_rules.checkout: Stuff never completes checkout or payment.
pass_rules.failure: Retailer login, challenge, load failure or website change must leave the user with a clear manual fallback rather than a stuck spinner.
